notes.zh: 审阅注：玩家舰队进入有无限神机的星系时触发（on_entering_system_fleet），若已接受“视界信号”剧情（worm_events_available）则不触发。选择后开启事件链与兴趣点，并在520–720天后发来“永恒的计算机”（1050）。
notes.en: Review note: fires when a player fleet enters the Machine's system (on_entering_system_fleet), but not if the Horizon Signal chain is active (worm_events_available). It starts the event chain and point of interest and schedules 'The Constant Calculator' (1050) 520-720 days later.

notes.zh: 审阅注：研究项目（360天）完成后的选择按理念互斥出现：非格式塔“连接主处理器”→对话；唯心“奉为圣物”（获得修正，无后续窗口）；唯物或格式塔“骇入”→骇入项目；尚武“找到自毁开关”→破坏项目。
notes.en: Review note: after the 360-day project, choices depend on ethics: non-gestalt 'contact the main processor' -> dialogue; spiritualist 'divine instrument' (modifier, no further window); materialist or gestalt 'hack' -> hacking project; militarist 'self-destruct' -> sabotage project.

notes.zh: 审阅注：当另一帝国摧毁或“释放”神机时，曾遇见神机的其他帝国收到此通知。
notes.en: Review note: shown to other empires that met the Machine when someone else destroys or releases it.

scope.zh: 完整：遭遇、1050延迟、研究项目、四种理念分支、对话、黑洞/骇入/破坏项目的随机与条件结果、战斗击毁、他国通知、与策展人的联系。
scope.en: Complete: encounter, delayed 1050, study project, four ethic branches, dialogue, black-hole/hacking/sabotage project results, destruction in battle, notice to others, Curator link.
